subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB2042
title: Requires the Oregon Health Authority to develop, implement and administer a program to support consumer engagement efforts aimed at increasing and optimizing consumer involvement in planning and decision-making surrounding the access to, and the delivery of, behavioral health services in this state.
headline: HB 2042 did not pass

claims.text: HB 2042 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
HB 2042 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
